exclusions.source_text: Participant is not pregnant or breastfeeding, and at least one of the following conditions applies:
Participants with known brain metastases are excluded from this clinical trial because of their poor prognosis
HIV-infected participants must have well-controlled HIV on ART, defined as:

Has uncontrolled, significant cardiovascular disease or cerebrovascular disease, including New York Heart Association Class III or IV congestive heart failure, unstable angina, myocardial infarction, uncontrolled symptomatic arrhythmia, prolongation of QTcF interval to >480 ms
exclusions.threshold: QTcF > 480 ms; NYHA Class III or IV

exclusions.source_text: Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or has required active treatment within the past 3 years.
Has CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
